title: JoinFX
description: JoinFX lets server owners fully configure join messages, leave messages, welcome messages, and join sounds through a simple config file. The plugin is designed to be minimal, customizable, and easy to use for any server.
body:
✨ **JoinFX** is a lightweight and customizable Minecraft Paper plugin that replaces the default join and leave messages with clean, modern ones.

⚙️ Server owners can fully customize **join messages, leave messages, welcome messages, and join sounds** through a simple config file. All messages are **fully configurable with colors**, and join/leave messages can be **enabled or disabled anytime**.

🔧 JoinFX is designed to be **minimal, flexible, and easy to configure**, making it perfect for any server that wants clean and customizable player join effects.
